title: ItemDemandCalculated
description: Published by the demand processor once a week per store, after that store's weekly figures are written. One message holds one store and at most 500 articles. Attributes: Tenant-Id, Business-Unit-Id, Correlation-Id, and Event-Id = <tenantId>:<businessUnitId>:<calculationDate>:<chunkIndex>. Ordering key: <tenantId>-<businessUnitId>.

businessUnitId.description: Id of the store the figures apply to

calculationDate.description: The Monday the figures apply from

windowWeeks.description: The store's window length in weeks used for this calculation

weeksAhead.description: The store's number of weeks ahead used for this calculation; also the length of every weeklyTrendFactors

calculatedDatetime.description: When the store's calculation ran. Identical across all chunks of one calculation

chunkIndex.description: 1-based position of this message among the store's chunks

chunkCount.description: Total number of chunks the store's week is published in

items.description: The articles in this chunk, at most 500

soldQuantity.description: Quantity sold of the article over the whole window

actualRatePerDay.description: Actual sales per day over the window, soldQuantity divided by the number of window days. 0 when the article had no window days

stockoutDays.description: Days of stockout in the window: the time the article was observed at the store minus the time it was in stock

promotionDaysExcluded.description: Number of promotion days dropped from the clean window

baseRatePerDay.description: Normal sales per day in sellable units, excluding promotion days and stockout time. Null when it could not be estimated; see baseRateMissingReason. Projected demand over a horizon is the sum, over the horizon's days, of baseRatePerDay multiplied by the factor of the week that day falls in.

baseRateMissingReason.description: Why baseRatePerDay is null, or null when it is set. NO_IN_STOCK_TIME: the article was not in stock on any day that is not a promotion day. NO_CLEAN_DAYS: every window day was a promotion day. NO_WINDOW_DAYS: the article had no stock position on any day of the window yet (first observed at the store on or after the window's end), so there is nothing to average; its actual figures are 0.

cleanInStockDays.description: In-stock days left in the window after promotion days are excluded

weeklyTrendFactors.description: Trend factor for each week ahead, exactly weeksAhead entries. Week 1 starts on calculationDate

trendSource.description: Level of the trend ladder the factors were taken from: the store, its country or its chain. NONE when no trend could be resolved, in which case every factor is 1.0

trendCategoryId.description: Id of the category whose trend was applied. Null when trendSource is NONE

trendMissingReason.description: Why no trend was resolved, or null when one was. NO_HISTORY: the winning level has no last-year baseline. NO_CATEGORY: the article has no category. INSUFFICIENT_VOLUME: no level of the ladder reached the minimum category quantity

isTrendClamped.description: True when at least one week's trend factor was moved by the store's minimum or maximum trend factor
